verdict.rationale: Live probes show an llms.txt served at docs.langchain.com that explicitly covers LangSmith documentation. Per-page Markdown versions (e.g. /langsmith/home.md, agent-auth.md) also exist and point agents to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be aimed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and the llms.txt is a shared LangChain-wide index rather than a LangSmith-specific one.
